# BarretOps

> BarretOps designs and 3D-prints custom parts and display pieces in Henderson / Las Vegas, Nevada:
> scale models, replacement parts, RC and drone accessories, and diecast display stands and wheel chocks.
> Customers send photos and measurements; BarretOps models the part in CAD, sends a render and a quote,
> prints it, test-fits it and ships it. BarretOps also publishes small mobile apps. BarretOps is a trade
> name of BWS Better Rides LLC, a Nevada limited liability company. Contact: barret@barretops.com

Key facts:

- Location: Henderson, Nevada (Las Vegas area). Ships across the United States.
- Custom work: send photos with a ruler in frame and any dimensions to barret@barretops.com. You approve a
  render and a quote before anything prints.
- Materials: PLA, PETG and TPU, chosen for the job (PETG for strength and heat, TPU for flex).
- Military and veterans: 10% off custom work - mention it when asking for a quote.
- Diecast line: 1:24 and 1:18 scale wheel chocks (sets of 20, black PETG), 1:24 display stands with custom
  two-color nameplates, sold on eBay with free US shipping.
- Every diecast batch is measured with calipers against the listed dimensions before it ships.

## 3D printing

- [Custom CAD design and 3D printing](https://barretops.com/#make): scale models, replacement parts, RC and
  drone accessories, display stands
- [Diecast display accessories](https://barretops.com/diecast/): wheel chocks and display stands for 1:18 and
  1:24 diecast cars, with links to the eBay listings

## Apps

- [Life](https://barretops.com/life/): one text box that sorts thoughts into tasks, reminders, bills, budgets,
  lists and calendar events, entirely on-device. iPhone and Android.
- [Invoice Maker for Trades](https://barretops.com/invoice/): invoices for tradespeople from a phone. iPhone.
- [Exact Print Studio](https://barretops.com/envelope/): address and print envelopes at exact size from a phone.
